races.name: Join Racing TV Now Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Vicki Vale
runners_data.note: Front-running style with 544 days off but uncontested early lead in small field could suit her perfectly
runners_data.comment: Absent since her fourth at Ludlow in October 2024; entitled to need this outing
runners_data.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner when trained by Dan Sketon, but absent since her fourth at Ludlow (2m5f, good) for this stable in October 2024 and entitled to benefit from this outing.

runners_data.name: Mermaids Cave
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with C&D win on good ground, amateur jockey Cian Murphy may struggle with tactical positioning
runners_data.comment: Seven hurdle wins; ran poorly last time but has slipped to a very good mark
runners_data.spotlight: 7-23 over hurdles, including a good-ground C&D win; beaten favourite in plating company two starts and pulled up in a subsequent handicap, but has slipped to a very good mark and can't be ruled out.

runners_data.name: Bitsnbuckles
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from in-form Olly Murphy yard, career-best form two runs ago suggests he's found his mark
runners_data.comment: Shade disappointing last time but earlier Southwell win was career-best form
runners_data.spotlight: Slightly disappointing when only fourth on his latest outing, but posted career-best form when winning readily by over 6l at Southwell (2m4f, good to soft) two starts ago and has an obvious claims if back at that level.

runners_data.name: Shotgun Rider
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who raced too freely last time, needs to settle better under Toby McCain-Mitchell
runners_data.comment: Spoiled chance by racing too freely on h'cap debut; first two hurdle runs were promising
runners_data.spotlight: Good-ground Irish point winner who was second behind useful rivals on first two hurdling starts (2m4f/2m2f); well beaten after racing too freely on last month's handicap debut but remains open to improvement if he settles better here.

runners_data.name: Coolkatie
runners_data.note: Prominent style mare with Harry Skelton up, was going well before last-flight fall at Warwick in December
runners_data.comment: Well held on handicap debut but the ground was heavy; still has potential
runners_data.spotlight: Unexposed mare who was set to be placed at least before last-flight fall in Warwick novice (2m5f, good to soft) in December; safely held on handicap debut at Exeter (2m, heavy) in February, but ought to be better suited by today's trip-and-ground combination; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Livano Bello
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who looks exposed with 0-11 hurdles record but has been placed in recent similar contests
runners_data.comment: 0-11 over hurdles but fairly consistent this season; probably won't be far away
runners_data.spotlight: 0-11 over hurdles and looks exposed, but was placed three consecutive times towards end of 2025 (2m4f-2m5f) and gave another good account when close third of five at Market Rasen (2m2f) three weeks ago; probably won't be far away.

runners_data.name: Painted Wolf
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who was close second over C&D last month, only 24 days since last run suggests he's in form
runners_data.comment: 0-5 over hurdles but was close second of four behind progressive rival over C&D last month
runners_data.spotlight: 0-5 over hurdles but left disappointing handicap debut behind when close second of four behind a progressive rival over C&D (good to soft) last month, and his Irish point form suggests he'll be fine on this faster ground.

races.paceDynamic: Vicki Vale will lead from the start with no other confirmed front-runners to pressure her early, allowing for a measured gallop through the first circuit. The prominent runners Shotgun Rider, Coolkatie, and Livano Bello will track behind while hold-up horses Mermaids Cave, Bitsnbuckles, and Painted Wolf settle further back. With only seven runners and a single pace-setter, this sets up as a tactical affair that will favour horses who can quicken from mid-division or those able to sustain a challenge from the back, making this a race for versatile types rather than pure front-runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Favours Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Vicki Vale maintains a steady tempo without being pressured early
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows prominent runners to get into ideal positions and kick clear before the hold-up horses can mount their challenges. This moderate gallop suits horses who can travel well in behind the leader rather than those needing a strong pace to set up their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kickback Rewards Patience
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly sedate and turns into a sprint from the last
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get their preferred scenario as the race becomes all about who has the most left in the tank over the final half-mile. Mermaids Cave and Bitsnbuckles have shown they can quicken strongly when getting the right setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Running Tactics Pay
scenarios.trigger: If Vicki Vale uses her uncontested lead to dictate throughout and prove hard to peg back
scenarios.body: Her 544-day absence becomes irrelevant as she gets an armchair ride in front, building an insurmountable advantage while the field plays catch-up too late. The lack of early pressure allows her to conserve energy for a strong finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Into Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses try to improve positions simultaneously approaching the final circuit
scenarios.body: The small field stretches out and positioning becomes crucial as several runners make their moves at once, creating gaps and traffic problems. This favours the most tactically astute jockeys who can find clear runs.

watchPoints.text: Vicki Vale could steal this if her 544-day absence doesn't show and she gets uncontested lead throughout
Shotgun Rider's tendency to race too freely could undo him again if he pulls hard early in the small field
Mermaids Cave has strong C&D record but amateur jockey Murphy may struggle with tactical ride from back
Coolkatie was going well before falling last time but comes here off 45-day break which could blunt her edge
Painted Wolf's close second over C&D last month makes him dangerous if getting similar strong pace setup

races.name: Aldiss Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Cotton Socks
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with decent bumper form but disappointing hurdling debut, 22 days since last run should have him spot-on
runners_data.comment: Placed in two junior bumpers; remote when third on recent hurdle debut; more needed
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in two junior bumpers towards end of last year (good to soft/soft), but was remote when third on hurdling debut at Market Rasen (2m, good to soft) and needs to improve to trouble an on-song Tralee Girl.

runners_data.name: Tralee Girl
runners_data.note: Class act with Listed placings over hurdles, prominent style suits the pace scenario and 72-day break freshens her up
runners_data.comment: Placed in two Listed hurdles in the autumn and very much the one to beat here
runners_data.spotlight: Fair Flat racer who was placed in Listed races at Wetherby (2m, good) and Newbury (2m, soft) on her first two hurdling starts; below that form in another Listed race in January but still very much the one to beat here.

runners_data.name: Subtle Glance
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced hold-up type with poor bumper form making hurdling debut, hood refitted suggests stable concerns
runners_data.comment: Well down the field in both bumpers and can only be watched on this hurdling debut
runners_data.spotlight: Well down the field in both bumpers and can only be watched on this hurdling debut; hood (worn on debut) refitted.

runners_data.name: Winston's Oath
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with modest ability, already behind Cotton Socks at Market Rasen and gives away weight here
runners_data.comment: Showed only minor promise in three bumpers and was well beaten on hurdling debut
runners_data.spotlight: Showed only minor promise in his three bumpers and was behind Cotton Socks when well-beaten sixth on recent hurdling debut at Market Rasen.

runners_data.name: Argentum
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse switching from low-grade Flat handicaps, 150-1 debut at Huntingdon suggests limited expectations
runners_data.comment: Placed in low-grade Flat handicaps last year but well beaten on recent hurdle debut
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in low-grade Flat handicaps at around 1m4f last year, but well beaten (albeit in deeper race than this) when 150-1 for recent hurdling debut at Huntingdon (2m, good).

runners_data.name: Whatcombe
runners_data.note: Front-runner with fading tendencies, 154 days off and stable switch creates uncertainty but Flat form was poor
runners_data.comment: Became very disappointing on the Flat and has a lot to prove on hurdling debut
runners_data.spotlight: Became very disappointing on the Flat for Paul and Oliver Cole and was well beaten on both starts for this stable in the autumn (1m6f/1m4f; wore cheekpieces); has a lot to prove on hurdling debut; no headgear this time.

runners_data.name: Fitzroy Gardens
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with one Flat win, 5lb claimer takes off useful weight but faces stronger opposition

races.paceDynamic: Whatcombe appears to be the sole confirmed pace-setter with Cotton Socks, Tralee Girl, Winston's Oath and Fitzroy Gardens all sitting prominently behind. This creates a solid early tempo that should suit those tracking the pace, with Whatcombe likely to weaken given his finishing concerns over this trip. The prominent runners get first run on the hold-up horses Argentum and Subtle Glance, who face a tough task from the back in a small field. This pace shape clearly favours the prominent runners who can track Whatcombe and kick when he falters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Whatcombe sets reasonable fractions but fades as expected in the closing stages
scenarios.body: The prominent quartet get perfect positioning to strike when the leader weakens, with the hold-up pair too far back to make meaningful late challenges. Tralee Girl and Cotton Socks have the class edge over Winston's Oath and Fitzroy Gardens in this tactical battle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Whatcombe stops quickly or the early pace becomes crawling slow
scenarios.body: A sprint finish develops where the hold-up horses Argentum and Subtle Glance can make ground, though Tralee Girl's superior class should still prevail. The tactical race becomes more open with finishing kick paramount over positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Whatcombe Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner's stamina holds better than his profile suggests
scenarios.body: The pace-setter completes a surprise wire-to-wire victory as the prominent runners struggle to reel him in over the final furlong. His recent stable switch and hurdling debut could unlock improvement that his Flat form didn't suggest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the form horses all underperform or encounter trouble
scenarios.body: Subtle Glance or Argentum capitalizes on a messy race where the fancied runners don't fire. This requires either a significant pace collapse or the outsiders showing marked improvement over their previous efforts.

watchPoints.text: Whatcombe's early pace-setting - if he goes too fast early he'll stop dramatically and hand the race to the prominent trackers
Tralee Girl's fitness after 72 days off - any ring rustiness could hand the initiative to the in-form Cotton Socks
Subtle Glance's jumping on hurdling debut - hood refitted suggests nerves but any fluency could see her outrun odds
The pace development after two furlongs - if it becomes stop-start the hold-up horses Argentum and Subtle Glance gain chances
Winston's Oath and Cotton Socks renewal - their Market Rasen form gives a direct line with Winston's Oath needing major improvement

races.name: Aldiss "Chasing Excellence" Novices' Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Kilaro
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who can set sustainable pace without pressure, improving novice with recent winning form but relatively inexperienced over fences
runners_data.comment: Point/bumper winner; makes chasing debut having bypassed hurdles; interesting
runners_data.spotlight: Won good-ground maiden point in November and followed up in good style in Musselburgh bumper (good to soft) on rules debut in December; not discredited when third in quite valuable Kelso bumper (good to soft; hooded) last month and Tim Easterby is evidently very keen to launch his chasing career.

runners_data.name: Sonigino
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs strong pace to close into, veteran with useful hurdling form but inconsistent since return from long absence
runners_data.comment: Very useful hurdler; showed form on only one of three starts this season; chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: Very useful hurdler with 6-22 strike-rate; has shown his form on only one of three starts since returning from a long absence this season, when close third at Sandown (2m4f, good) two starts ago, but has obvious claims if on song for this chasing debut.

runners_data.name: Walking On Air
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with highest official rating, shown very useful form in cheekpieces but question marks over longer trip effectiveness
runners_data.comment: Very useful on his good days but 0-10 over fences and very inconsistent
runners_data.spotlight: Very useful on his good days, the latest when third in Great Yorkshire Chase at Doncaster (3m, soft; first-time cheekpieces) in January; subsequent 3m6f Cheltenham Festival defeat can be excused and he'll be fine on the forecast good ground here, but he's 0-10 over fences and very inconsistent.

races.paceDynamic: Kilaro will take them along from the front in this small field, likely setting a steady gallop without pressure from just three runners. With Sonigino preferring to be held up and Walking On Air sitting prominent, there's no early pace pressure on the leader. The lack of genuine pace pressure should create a tactical affair where positioning and jumping become crucial. This shape favours front runners and prominent racers who can control their own destiny rather than hold-up horses who need a strong pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Kilaro Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Kilaro jumps cleanly and maintains his lead without serious challenge
scenarios.body: The improving novice can dictate terms at his own pace and prove hard to pass with his recent winning form. His style perfectly suits a race where he can bowl along in front without pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Walking On Air Times Run
scenarios.trigger: If Walking On Air's class tells and he can get into a rhythm from his prominent position
scenarios.body: The very useful performer can use his higher rating and tactical speed to strike at the right moment. His prominent style works well when he can track the pace and pounce.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sonigino's Late Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes strong enough in the closing stages for Sonigino to mount his customary late challenge
scenarios.body: The Paul Nicholls-trained hold-up horse needs others to go fast enough to set up his finish. His class could tell if the race develops into a staying test.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Jumping Decides Everything
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make significant jumping errors that shuffle the pack
scenarios.body: Poor jumping from any runner could completely change the complexion with only three runners. The one who jumps best will have a huge advantage regardless of tactics.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Sonigino gets detached early as his hold-up style needs others to go fast enough ahead of him in this small field
Watch Kilaro's jumping technique under pressure as any serious error could end his chance of controlling the race from the front
Watch Walking On Air's settling in cheekpieces as his prominent style needs him to travel kindly behind Kilaro
Watch the pace through the middle section as too slow could favour the leader too much while too fast might not develop
Watch how Freddie Gingell positions Sonigino early as getting too far back in a slowly-run race could be fatal

races.name: Cecil & Sheila Buttifant Memorial Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Best Women
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with highest class rating but 76 days off and needs everything to fall right from the back

runners_data.name: Four Decades
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who tends to race too freely but could benefit if allowed to dictate her own tempo
runners_data.comment: Showed promise in 2m Kempton maiden in February and is bred for this much longer trip
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in latest qualifying race (raced too freely) but her midfield finish at Kempton (2m, good to soft) two starts ago was promising, and her pedigree suggests she'll be suited by this hike up in trip on her handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Callmesusie
runners_data.note: Hold-up style from in-form trainer Louise Allan but inconsistent recent form and question marks over fitness

runners_data.name: Abbey Law
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with solid recent fourth at Ludlow and proven course winner who handles good ground well

runners_data.name: Annie Nail
runners_data.note: Experienced hold-up performer who won here previously but inconsistent form and 64 days since last run
runners_data.comment: Far too inconsistent to rely upon but runs this track well and enters calculations
runners_data.spotlight: Won a chase here (2m5f, good) last May and returned to form with 66-1 second in soft-ground C&D hurdle in December; safely held twice since and too inconsistent to rely upon, but still features prominently in calculations.

races.paceDynamic: Four Decades is the only confirmed front runner in this five-horse field and should dictate terms from the outset without pressure. With four hold-up horses (Best Women, Callmesusie, Abbey Law, Annie Nail) likely to settle behind her, the pace will be comfortable and sustainable through the early stages. This creates a tactical puzzle where Four Decades could steal a march if allowed her own way, but the quartet behind will be eyeing their moment to pounce in the final half-mile. This race shape strongly favours horses who can quicken from off the pace, as the gentle early gallop will set up a sprint finish that suits hold-up performers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals March
scenarios.trigger: If Four Decades is allowed uncontested lead and dictates comfortable fractions
scenarios.body: The field settles too far behind and Four Decades builds an insurmountable advantage, with hold-up horses unable to close the gap despite late rallies. Her prominent racing style and ability to control tempo proves decisive in this tactical affair.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold Up Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays genuinely steady and multiple horses challenge together
scenarios.body: The gentle early gallop sets up a bunched field turning for home, creating a cavalry charge finish that favours the strongest stayer. Best Women's class and Abbey Law's recent form could shine in this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid Race Acceleration
scenarios.trigger: If Four Decades increases tempo significantly from halfway point
scenarios.body: Her tendency to race too freely resurfaces and she strings out the field with sustained pressure, eliminating some hold-up horses but potentially setting up one strong closer. This tactical move could backfire if she empties her tank.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to commit early and they crawl through halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a stop-start affair with multiple horses still in contention at the last hurdle, creating chaos where any of the hold-up horses could emerge. Form and class become secondary to who gets the clearest run.

watchPoints.text: Four Decades breaking clear early - if she gets soft lead through first mile she could be gone
Best Women's jumping - 76 days off and needs to be sharp over hurdles from hold-up position
Jack Quinlan's tactics on Callmesusie - needs to judge pace perfectly from the back in small field
Abbey Law's position turning in - must be close enough to strike as proven hold-up horse
Annie Nail's fitness after 64-day break - veteran needs everything right to reproduce December form

races.name: Watch On Racing TV Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Cloudy Wednesday
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner with three course wins who should get an easy lead but faces returning from 26-day break
runners_data.comment: Won the last two editions of this race and returns here after two good runs last month
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time course winner, including last two editions of this race (both on good ground); returned from layoff with two pretty good efforts at Huntingdon (2m7f/2m4f) last month and commands respect back here.

runners_data.name: Brother Boris
runners_data.note: Fellow pace-setter who could pressure the leader early but questionable form value from weak opposition in recent wins
runners_data.comment: Bids for course hat-trick after two wide-margin wins in two-finisher events
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner who bids to complete a Fakenham hat-trick after two wide-margin wins in two-finisher contests this year (3m5f, soft/3m, good to soft); the value of his form is tricky to evaluate and today's faster ground may not be ideal but, nevertheless, another bold bid seems likely.

runners_data.name: Reforme
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with class edge returning from 97-day layoff under in-form Quinlan partnership
runners_data.comment: Shade fortunate to win over C&D in October but still considered
runners_data.spotlight: Probably fortunate to win off today's mark over C&D (good to soft; leader fell at final fence) in October, but that was still a good effort and his next two runs were respectable; contender if tuned up after 97-day break.

runners_data.name: Another Mystery
runners_data.note: Prominent type dropping back from hurdles with 10lb lower mark but 309 days since last chase start creates stamina doubts
runners_data.comment: Second over hurdles here last spring but this year's point form is uninspiring
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up over hurdles here (2m4f, good; first-time blinkers) on latest rules start last June and competes off a 10lb lower mark today, but his chasing strike-rate is 0-11 and this year's point form is uninspiring.

runners_data.name: Crac De Megaudais
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who needs strong pace but hasn't convinced over fences in recent starts despite previous course hurdles win
runners_data.comment: Course winner over hurdles last season but well beaten in his last three chases
runners_data.spotlight: Won by 12l over hurdles here (2m4f, good) last season but well beaten in his last three chases, most recently when back here (2m5f) in January; needs a revival on this first attempt at 3m.

races.paceDynamic: Cloudy Wednesday will lead from the start with his proven front-running style, while Brother Boris may try to challenge early given his own prominent tactics. With just five runners and two natural pace-setters, the gallop should be honest but not frantic over this 3m trip. Reforme and Another Mystery will track in behind, while Crac De Megaudais settles last. This moderate pace with multiple prominent runners favours horses that can travel well in behind and finish strongly, benefiting hold-up types and those with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Cloudy Wednesday Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Cloudy Wednesday gets an uncontested lead and Brother Boris settles behind him
scenarios.body: The proven course specialist dictates a steady gallop that suits his stamina, with the race becoming a staying test where his local knowledge and fitness edge tells. His three previous course wins give him a decisive tactical advantage in a slowly-run affair.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Boris Pressure Cooker
scenarios.trigger: If Brother Boris forces the pace early and puts Cloudy Wednesday under pressure
scenarios.body: The two front-runners engage in a pace duel that sets up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses tracking behind them. Crac De Megaudais gets the perfect scenario with a strong gallop to aim at, while both leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too slow and multiple horses are still in contention turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last fence with tactical speed more important than stamina. Reforme's class and Quinlan's timing become decisive factors in a bunched finish where positioning matters most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Grind
scenarios.trigger: If the good ground rides faster than expected and creates a true test of staying power
scenarios.body: The 3m trip becomes a genuine stamina examination where only the most genuine stayers survive to contest the finish. Cloudy Wednesday's proven course form and Another Mystery's hurdles fitness become the key factors in a war of attrition.

watchPoints.text: Brother Boris may go too fast early trying to deny Cloudy Wednesday an easy lead, compromising both front-runners
Another Mystery's fitness after 309 days off chasing - any early jumping errors could end her chances quickly
Reforme needs Quinlan to get him into the right position early as he can be keen and waste energy if not settled
Crac De Megaudais requires a truly-run race to show his best but may get outpaced if they go steady throughout
Cloudy Wednesday's jumping under pressure if Brother Boris forces a duel - he's made errors when challenged before

races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Milliedram
runners_data.comment: Interesting pedigree, but stable not known for bumper winners
runners_data.spotlight: £1,500 3yo; ninth foal; half-sister to winners Gaitway (bumper/2m hurdle), Diamond Gait (bumper/2m hurdle) and Commander Miller (2m3f hurdle); dam 7f 2yo winner, half-sister to smart Flat/useful hurdle winner Bold Gait; interesting pedigree, but stable not known for bumper winners.

runners_data.name: Crescendo Lady
runners_data.comment: Fifth foal; sister to low-grade hurdle winner Libor Lad; limited appeal on paper
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth foal; sister to low-grade hurdle winner Libor Lad; dam well beaten in bumpers; makes only limited appeal on paper.

runners_data.name: On The Cobbles
runners_data.comment: First foal from unraced sister to useful jumper Golden Taipan; yard very quiet in bumpers
runners_data.spotlight: First foal from unraced sister to useful jumper Golden Taipan; stable 0-42 in bumpers during the last five seasons.

runners_data.name: Hidden Fortune
runners_data.comment: Irish point winner; second on rules debut in November (form recently boosted by winner)
runners_data.spotlight: Stoutly bred mare who joined Dan Skelton after winning by 5l on Irish point debut (good to yielding) last spring; second of five in race that developed into a sprint at Market Rasen (good to soft) on rules debut in November; that form was boosted when the winner overcame a penalty last week, and this mare can probably improve if there's more emphasis on stamina here.

runners_data.name: L'Amandine
runners_data.comment: Third of 11 on debut at Ludlow in January; stable has excellent bumper record
runners_data.spotlight: Out of a French hurdle/chase winner; represents stable with excellent bumper strike-rate (25%) and kept on for third of 11 on debut at Ludlow (good to soft) in January; major player.

runners_data.name: Blue's Secret Gem
runners_data.comment: With a good stable and made quite encouraging debut when fourth of seven at Plumpton
runners_data.spotlight: With a good stable and made quite encouraging debut when fourth of seven at Plumpton (good to soft) last month; no surprise if she makes the necessary progress here.
